overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a highly focused and professional social media presence across specialized platforms. His content appeals directly to academic, computational social science, and data science audiences, achieving high relative engagement rates by focusing on research publications, software releases, and academic recruitment.

contentThemes.description: Announcements of academic papers, grants, and conference presentations on disinformation and information operations.
Job openings and research opportunities targeting PhD students and postdoctoral researchers in computational fields.
Technical updates and releases of specialized research tools such as CooRnet.

recommendations: Leverage LinkedIn's larger follower base by increasing the frequency of posts, particularly for recruitment and funding milestones to maximize reach.
Incorporate more visual media, such as screenshots of CooRnet or publication figures, to boost click-through and sharing rates on Mastodon and Bluesky.
Utilize hashtags more consistently across Bluesky and Mastodon to tap into broader academic and software-development communities.

platformInsights.bluesky: Yields the highest average engagement rate (6.14%), driven by an active community that frequently reposts publications and academic opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves as an effective, highly technical channel for specialized tool updates like CooRnet, though with lower overall follower-to-interaction volume.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest absolute engagement numbers and is highly effective for professional outreach, recruitment, and high-profile research milestones.

topPerformingContent.content: Just published our new paper on coordinated inauthentic behavior on social media platforms!
New research opportunity for PhD students interested in computational social science. Reply for details!
